scope: Default PR CI; optional install and SFW jobs skipped as on unlabeled PRs.
controls: Identical source, toolchain, dependency pins and runner labels.
Same branch and shared isolated cache namespace for both variants.
Cold: no Cargo, pnpm, SDK or native binary cache restore or save.
Prime: save isolated caches, excluded from timing.
Warm: exact cache hits required; all saves disabled.
Zig action cache disabled for all runs.
Hosted image/tool download caches and public network services are not controlled.
